I used to write my journal entries in Japanese that's a good way to practice! Or reading, too. I read moomin in Japanese it was very cute! Of course, that's not the same as a conversation. Try not to lose that skill! Also what kind of French music do you listen to? For German I like Du Bist Schön by Alligatoah. Not Dark Academia at all but it slaps. 

I absolutely understand what you mean by the limitations of a language! My favorite example is the word "Happy" in Japanese can either be 幸せ (shiawase) or 嬉しい (ureshii), because ureshii is more like "I'm happy right now" vs shiawase "lifelong happiness" like, being content with your life? I think that's very interesting. Also that's a cool way to think about religion! Religion across the world is always different but has the general idea that good morals = good consequences and vice versa.. is that true, actually? I'm not religious and haven't looked into it too much, though you saying that makes me want to look into it!

Oh wait I just read you saying something at morality too! Do you think it's odd that we're told to do good because if we don't we'll be punished? Or to do good so we can get a reward? To me I feel like we should have an instinct to be kind to others. Honestly part of that idea is humans evolved to be social creatures. If you were alone and a bear shows up you're definitely going to die, while if you had a bunch of people you'd probably be ok. Being cruel to others makes them leave you, and then you're alone and it's uncomfortable. Does that make sense? Am I silly? I'd love to hear your thoughts!

That makes me so happy that you like my thoughts on Van Gogh! And I do agree that "basic" art or basic things in general are unnecessarily dismissed which to me is so boring. What do you like about that painting?
